title: A Lean formalization of Bayesian bandit value interpolation
contribution_type: complete formalization of an established Bayesian bandit theorem
claim: For the exact independent-arm Bayesian model with measurable conjugate updates and integrable predictive rewards, Ukn(k,n+1) <= Ukn(k,n) for all n<T, together with WFH=Ukn(0,0), WVZ=Ukn(K-1,T) and Ukn(k+1,0)=Ukn(k,T). The proof establishes the finite-history posterior under the actual product outcome law; it is not an extra assumption.

publication.note: Central source disclosure and DOI archival are separate events. No existing interpolation DOI covers this result.

limitations: The platform assumptions include a nonempty standard Borel latent-parameter space, measurable conjugate updates and integrable predictive rewards for every belief.
The formalized S sums posterior predictive means, exactly as defined in the platform model; it is not the sum of observed rewards.
The platform already corrected the middle coefficient to use arm k; that clarification is credited to mikedeng1.
This exact theorem does not establish every information-relaxation comparison or the remaining supersolution milestones.
No mathematical novelty, independent human peer review, source-author endorsement or exhaustive novelty search is claimed.
